content.about: Liechtenstein is a tiny, doubly landlocked country in the Alps, between Switzerland and Austria. It is ruled by a prince who lives in a castle above the capital, Vaduz. Its people enjoy one of the highest incomes in the world. Hiking trails cross the whole country.

standout.text: Liechtenstein is one of the world's largest makers of false teeth.

didYouKnow: Liechtenstein is one of only two doubly landlocked countries.
You can walk across the whole country in a day.
